headlines.description: Argentina beat France 4-2 on penalties to win the 2022 World Cup after a 3-3 draw in a thrilling final at the Lusail Stadium in Doha, Qatar.
headlines.shortLinkText: Argentina beat France on pens to win World Cup

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal!  Argentina 1, France 0. Lionel Messi (Argentina) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal!  Argentina 2, France 0. Ángel Di María (Argentina) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Alexis Mac Allister   following a fast break.
Substitution, France. Randal Kolo Muani replaces Ousmane Dembélé.
Substitution, France. Marcus Thuram replaces Olivier Giroud.
Enzo Fernández (Argentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Adrien Rabiot (France) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Argentina. Marcos Acuña replaces Ángel Di María.
Substitution, France. Kingsley Coman replaces Antoine Griezmann.
Substitution, France. Eduardo Camavinga replaces Théo Hernández.
Goal!  Argentina 2, France 1. Kylian Mbappé (France) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal!  Argentina 2, France 2. Kylian Mbappé (France) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Marcus Thuram.
Marcus Thuram (France) is shown the yellow card.
Olivier Giroud (France) is shown the yellow card.
Marcos Acuña (Argentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half Extra Time begins Argentina 2, France 2.
Substitution, Argentina. Gonzalo Montiel replaces Nahuel Molina.
Substitution, France. Youssouf Fofana replaces Adrien Rabiot because of an injury.
Substitution, Argentina. Leandro Paredes replaces Rodrigo De Paul.
Substitution, Argentina. Lautaro Martínez replaces Julián Álvarez.
Second Half Extra Time begins Argentina 2, France 2.
Goal!  Argentina 3, France 2. Lionel Messi (Argentina) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, France. Ibrahima Konaté replaces Raphaël Varane because of an injury.
Leandro Paredes (Argentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Argentina. Germán Pezzella replaces Alexis Mac Allister.
Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) is shown the yellow card for hand ball.
Goal!  Argentina 3, France 3. Kylian Mbappé (France) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, France. Axel Disasi replaces Jules Koundé.
Substitution, Argentina. Paulo Dybala replaces Nicolás Tagliafico.
Penalty Shootout begins Argentina 3, France 3.
Emiliano Martínez (Argentina) is shown the yellow card.
